# Staged fixed Business12 Android route

Artifact-only preparation. Not installed, dispatched or submitted. Root must independently review, integrate, pin the resulting workflow source, inspect actual existing locale IDs, resolve rights, and provide genuine final candidate inputs first. The staged catalog deliberately leaves all twelve products PENDING.

Run offline CPU checks: `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s .github/scoped-business-submit/tests -v`.
The installed entrypoint must be `business_cli.py`; `cli.py` retains calculator9 defaults solely for unchanged regression coverage. No CLI family/track/version/free-URL inputs exist. The existing calculator workflow/file paths and four original read-only preflight files are not modified. Do not install the reference calculator workflow snapshot from this artifact; only the new workflow and scoped-business-submit directory are proposed additions.

The fixed twelve packages, exact previous production/max codes, versions, source commits/trees/product digests, selected source/sign workflow paths and byte hashes, artifact names and per-app certificates derive from SHA-pinned `business-source-manifest.json` and retained successful `provider-previous-state.json`. No current production or pending-review outcome is inferred from that earlier snapshot: submit performs a new bounded snapshot and requires previous production/max exactly and target=max+1 before any upload. It preserves nonproduction tracks, listing text/details, availability, country targeting and release priority, and confirms staged and committed readbacks.

Eleven central routes require distinct source and signing runs/artifacts, original unsigned CI ZIP and signed CI ZIP, same non-signature AAB payload, original payload.json/public upload certificate and actual Java/bundletool certificate/package/version verification. NavoKids instead requires its actual single managed-EAS signed source artifact and distinct 1F600B... / 597A7E... public certificate; no central signer is invented. FINISHED, frozen managed credentials, exact source/workflow run, normal portfolioAndroid local-version/autoIncrement=false override, non-recovered build, no prior store submission and exact AAB hash are required. Actual official GitHub GETs recheck selected main/manual/successful source/sign run paths and immutable artifact IDs/digests. Metadata client is read-only and fixed to these twelve source repositories and the own private draft repository.

Preparation obtains no Google identity. It checks the existing own unpublished draft asset by numeric ID, exact business-candidate-<package>-<fixedVersion>-<code>.zip name and raw SHA, original ZIPs and all candidate gates. It freezes two files by immutable artifact ID and a run/source/catalog-bound attestation. Submit revalidates both bytes before the existing WIF identity. Prepare-only contents:write is necessary because GitHub draft-release visibility requires push permission; its production client nevertheless only implements bounded GET/download routes. Submit/inspect keep contents:read and id-token:write. No new credential or IAM setup is introduced.

Candidate schema retains the proven calculator manifest fields, with these Business additions:
- `rootReview` and `rightsEvidence`: normal `{path,sha256}` entries under qa/, whose raw hashes must already be fixed in the reviewed catalog.
- Central `source.archive`: original unsigned CI ZIP path, digest equal to its official source artifact digest. `signing.archive` is the original signed CI ZIP.
- NavoKids has no `signing` field; `source.archive` is its original EAS signed CI ZIP, with the pinned signed artifact name.
- Exactly four genuine phone frames for each actual existing German/English store listing ID from a successful owned-edit inventory. Store listing locale is independent from visible app UI language. Each includes original native PNG and lossless RGB24 PNG with identical decoded pixels. Limits320..3840, max2:1, opaque, unique within each locale. No resized/mock or old720x1600 QA frames.
- Per-app `frameLanguageRequirements` remains null until root reviews actual source and each frame. Pin four declarations for each listing ID: `inAppLanguage` is de, en or mixed-de-en; `mixedUi` is a true boolean matching mixed content; `languageLimitation` describes mixed portions or any listing/UI-language difference. The corresponding candidate screenshot entries must match all three fields exactly. German UI in an English store listing is allowed with an explicit German declaration and limitation; listing/device locale/filename never proves English UI. Mixed legacy German navigation and English panels must be declared with the mixed flag and specific limitation.
- Business QA uses `listingLocales` for selected store IDs and rejects the ambiguous legacy `captureLanguages` field. Actual UI declarations are per frame in the root-reviewed screenshot bindings. The unchanged calculator9 schema keeps its own legitimate existing language evidence.
- Fresh normal Android QA binds source, AAB, actual tested APK and screenshots, explicit launch/main/navigation/font/assets results and no real purchases/restores/redemptions/ad impressions. Its apkProof must hashlist actualDerivedApkFile and actualInstalledHashRawProof in qa.proof. Raw DEX/JNI/assets/baseline bytes must match the signed AAB and the direct installed /data/app/<exact-package>-*/base.apk SHA output must match the actual tested APK bytes. Compiled resources/manifest formats are not falsely claimed raw-identical.
- Exact raw requiredBundleAssets hashes include known original fonts and original OFL/license/notice files and observed own artwork; all bytes are checked inside the signed AAB. Existing static observations are not a blanket rights clearance.
- Rights evidence has schema1, reviewer root, outcome cleared_for_distribution, exact package/source and requiredBundleAssets, plus1..16 hashlisted raw proof entries also included in qa.proof. Root review has schema1, reviewer root, outcome approved_candidate_inputs, exact package/source/version/AAB/APK/native QA SHA/screenshots/rights SHA, rootVisuallyReviewedAllEight=true and fresh testedAtUtc. The catalog pins both reports before any candidate can pass. Pending, missing or uncertain ownership is never automatically approved.

The default `inspect` operation creates only its own temporary edit, GETs existing listings, and confirms DELETE (204/404 or documented empty200 JSON). It cannot upload, mutate tracks, validate or commit; all-twelve is inspection-only. An unknown create/delete stops the bounded batch for reconciliation.

`submit` is explicit one app, first manual main attempt only. It performs one owned edit and one commit using changesInReviewBehavior=ERROR_IF_IN_REVIEW, always. There is no CANCEL/default fallback, blind upload/commit retry, timer, app loop or automatic resubmission. Known in-review rejection deletes the owned uncommitted edit. Unknown commit outcome preserves that edit and stops for read-only reconciliation. Success requires acknowledged exact edit, fresh readback and confirmed deletion of its owned readback edit; it means submitted_for_review, never public release. Receipts contain no credential/provider bodies/signed download URLs.

Missing evidence now: actual Business locale inventory and per-app/per-frame visible language review (no full English UI claim); eight exact-signed-AAB normal-native final frames/QA per app; final root candidate and asset-rights review; complete remaining raw font/notice inventories where not observed; factual locale-bound release notes; integrated reviewed workflow execution commit. No business pack, provider result or approval is fabricated. Apple, retired/suspended apps, both OneMoreFloor identities, new listings and the five separate in-review submissions are excluded.

Primary behavior references retained from the proven route: https://developers.google.com/android-publisher/api-ref/rest/v3/edits/commit (ERROR_IF_IN_REVIEW); edits.bundles/upload, edits.tracks/update, edits/validate; https://docs.github.com/en/rest/releases/releases (draft visibility). No network call was made to Google in this preparation.
